info.title: Sarafa Business API
info.description: Server-side access to your verified organization's account. Use Bearer API keys, decimal-string amounts, and unique merchant references. Charge, transfer, and swap default to quotes. Only transaction.status = completed confirms payment.

200.description: Organization and account associated with your API key.

get.description: All wallets for your organization. No pagination.
Read a wallet and available deposit addresses. Does not provision addresses.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of a wallet belonging to your account.

get.description: Transactions for an owned wallet, newest first.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of a wallet belonging to your account.

get.description: Read by tx_reference. Only transaction.status = completed confirms payment.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Sarafa tx_reference, not the merchant reference or a database ID.

200.description: Payment status and quote. This example is awaiting approval.

post.description: Collect KES/UGX mobile money into USD, or request USD/SSP approval from an eligible Sarafa customer or merchant. Sarafa requests expire after 15 minutes; creation moves no funds. Quote defaults to true.

200.description: Quote, or resolved execution. Only transaction.status = completed confirms payment.

mobileQuote.summary: Illustrative mobile estimate; actual pricing is returned by the API.

202.description: Payment pending or awaiting reconciliation. Example: Sarafa approval request.

post.description: Send USD/SSP to an active Sarafa customer, or debit USD principal plus fees for a KES/UGX mobile payout. Quote defaults to true.

mobile.summary: Quote a USD to UGX mobile payout

200.description: Quote, or resolved execution. Only transaction.status = completed confirms payment.

202.description: Mobile payment pending or awaiting reconciliation.

post.description: Convert USD to/from USDC or USDT at 1:1, with 3% deducted from proceeds. This moves wallet balances, not blockchain funds. Quote defaults to true.

usdToUsdc.summary: Quote a USD to USDC swap

200.description: Quote, or resolved execution. Only transaction.status = completed confirms payment.

post.description: Create a fixed-amount, single-payment USD invoice. Supports card, Sarafa, and KES/UGX mobile payments. Returns the same link on an identical retry. Does not accept quote.

201.description: Created checkout, or an identical replay.

get.description: Read checkout state and associated payment attempts. Browser redirects are not proof of payment.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Your merchant reference used at checkout creation.

200.description: Checkout status: open, paid, or closed.

bearerAuth.description: Use the full key from the merchant dashboard API section. Keep it on your server.

RequestId.description: Include this request identifier when contacting support.

request_id.description: Present on processing errors. Every response also includes X-Request-Id.

address.description: Null unless the assignment is verified and monitoring is active.

quote_token.description: Optional token returned for mobile estimates. Include it on execution to detect a changed estimate, and preserve it on execution retries.
Optional token returned for mobile estimates. Include it on execution to detect a changed estimate, and preserve it on execution retries.

tx_reference.description: Sarafa payment reference. Newly generated references are 13 characters; existing longer references remain valid.

status.description: Payment state. Only completed confirms payment; pending and needs_review are not final. Failed approvals can include a rejection or expiry reason.

reference.description: Merchant reference, or null for records without API identity.

expires_at.description: Present on approval requests; approval expires 15 minutes after creation.

reason.description: Present on approval requests; rejected or expired when applicable.

checkout_url.description: Redirect the payer to this URL.

transactions.description: Payment attempts, newest first. Read a transaction by tx_reference for its currency, quote, and approval details.

event_id.description: Stable event identifier; deduplicate deliveries by this value.

amount.description: Positive decimal string, not a JSON number. Zero is invalid. Currency-specific precision and payment limits also apply.

reference.description: Your idempotency reference, unique across charge, transfer, swap, and checkout creation within your organization. Reuse it with unchanged details for execution retries.

callback_url.description: HTTPS URL without embedded credentials. Required even for quotes. Receives signed payment callbacks.

quote.description: True returns a quote without moving funds or creating a transaction. Set false to execute.

account_number.description: Eligible payer customer or merchant account.

amount.description: KES amount with up to two decimal places.

Error400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, amount, precision, or currency/channel combination.

Error401.description: Missing, invalid, inactive, or revoked API key.

Error404.description: Resource not found within your organization.

Error409.description: Conflicting reference, insufficient balance, changed quote, or payment-state conflict.

Error500.description: Processing failure. Retry uncertain executions with the same reference and unchanged payload.
